# P28 - Final publicity review with immutable evidence

Status: **blocked_external**. Independent local implementation delivered; actual provider/JWT/concurrent-session/institutional/privacy/human gates remain. No P29 implementation or social posting.

## Delivered contract

Migration036;83tables/902columns/110public functions. Six forced-RLS/raw-denied immutable tables: publicity_reviews, publicity_approvals, publicity_approval_events, publicity_authority_designations, publicity_review_policies, publicity_review_bindings. New privileged unit-scoped `mcd.review` capability preserves existing capability/scope restrictions; no actual permission, designation, policy or institutional configuration is seeded. Official same-term designation/version/primary-or-alternate and a published confirmed single-stage/one-reviewer terminal MCD policy are required. Other routing remains paused until an approved typed mapping exists, matching P26's bounded adapter pattern.

`submit_publicity_request` freezes final app image/PDF manifest/hash, caption/copy, credits, identity, checklist attestations, channel, intended use/date, source URL/custody mode, related deliverable and optional exact FIN revision. Exported-source mode also requires a validated supporting Canva/Drive link; link alone never substitutes for frozen app bytes. P12 owns immutable rendition custody; no external preview/fetch/OAuth is introduced. Attestations and a source link do not prove institutional branding rights or external source ownership. Typed payload hash binds request revision, envelope and final manifest hashes. Every governed field/change needs a new explicit revision; old approvals and snapshots remain immutable. External source edits do not rewrite the frozen snapshot or automatically approve a replacement.

Typed activate/decide/revoke commands reuse P22 canonical assignments, decisions and events, with exact revision/policy/authority/decision/hash/manifest bindings. Generic FIN/MCD review hooks remain closed; no general approval/completion outcome is fabricated. Requester self-approval and FIN/department substitutes fail closed. Current term/person/admission/deployment/role/designation/policy/version and assignment are rechecked; target/scope/policy locks, READ COMMITTED, exact actor/key/payload retry, redacted audit/outbox and rollback apply. Conditions and finite term-bound approval expiry are explicit. Revocation, expiry, governed drafts/revisions/cancellation or lost policy/authority invalidate current MCD readiness.

Cost-bearing publication has a separate FIN result. The selected current financial revision must match requester, related deliverable and intended-use/purpose exactly, with current FIN authorization, no closed commitment or unresolved actuals. Every other current related FIN plan must also be valid. A no-cost declaration cannot waive existing related financial plans. This is a conservative local mapping; institutional coverage of the defined use remains a human gate. FIN authorization is never payment/settlement verification; MCD never issues financial authorization. Shared task/deliverable `read_publicity_gate` returns exactly not_verified/pending/reviewed, without copy, identity, case metadata/counts, amounts or receipts. Reviewed means only the local review predicates, not payment, posting or overall acceptance.

`read_publicity_request` audits work-version reads; requester may read history, only the current independent assignee may read current private contents/selected bytes. Reviewer receives only a neutral FIN outcome, not the private financial revision ID/payload. Current authority loss removes reads/actions/downloads. `publicity_options` exposes admitted requester/current-assignee cases and authorized choices only. `/publicity` and `/publicity/:term/:request` provide final intake, configured envelope form, P12 files, exact reviewer decision, history, revision and withdrawal. Creative collaboration stays in tasks. Existing requester MCD paths redirect to the typed page. Identity-bound memory retains conflict inputs and freezes identical uncertain payload/key; no optimistic approval or private browser persistence. Existing Karla/neutral/red/native44px/focus styling is reused.
